note: Reading step tunes from the staff: each tune is read and sung from its first note, then checked by singing along, then read again with the tune muted (Tune), so the bar runs and the mic draws the line with nothing leading. The tunes play at a beginner's 40, and the old Key selector is now moves (any key, 40 to 60 bpm), with the line about another key marked {{?key}}. missing: a melody-singer prop that starts the mic and the bar without playing the tune, so the very first reading is drawn too.

exercise.title: Read a tune that moves by step
exercise.why: On the staff a step is the move from a line to the space next to it, so a tune that moves only by step can be read one small move at a time from its first note.

cells.text:
Tap the first note of the tune below to hear it. Each note after it sits one step higher or lower on the staff. Sing the tune from the staff on the note names, at your own pace.
Then press Play below to hear the tune at {{=bpm}}: the mic starts with it. Sing along and check what you read.
Once your reading matches the tune, press Tune to mute it, and read it again while your line draws on the staff.
{{?key}}In another key the notes sit in new places on the staff, but each one is still a step from the last.

This tune starts on Sol and only steps down. Tap its first note below to hear it, and sing the tune from the staff on the note names. Then press Play below to hear it: the mic starts with it.
If you lose your place, tap the note you stopped on and go on from there.

This tune is four bars long, and each bar ends on a long note. Tap its first note below to hear it, and sing the tune from the staff on the note names, one bar at a time.
Then press Play below to hear the tune, and sing along to check each bar.
Practice until you can read it through without stopping, then sing it again on "oo".
